cc:Work.dc:title: B200 · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · one pod
cc:Work.dc:description: On one B200 the AX tree leads stock vLLM DFlash2 on every workload at one client; at eight clients AX GDN replay is within 2-7% of vLLM.
